# certkit

> Trusted local HTTPS certificates as a JavaScript library, CLI, and Vite plugin.

- [README](README.md): install, quick start, platform limits, comparison
- [CLI reference](docs/cli.md): commands, JSON output, exit codes
- [Trust matrix](docs/trust-matrix.md): per-platform verification evidence and limits
- [Node trust](docs/node-trust.md): system CA and CI/container recipes
- [Coming from devcert](docs/devcert-migration.md): coexistence and cleanup
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): development and pull request guidance
- [Release guide](docs/releasing.md): maintainer-only publication process
